verdict.rationale: Perplexity offers a developer API, including an Agent API, a Search API and a published OpenAPI spec, so asking about API versioning and deprecation policy is fair. The pack has no evidence of versioned API endpoints or a documented deprecation policy. Versioned agent profiles and model fallback are related but different features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
